company_name: Eco World Project Management Sdn Bhd
semiconductor_relevance: Low — Eco World Project Management Sdn Bhd focuses on industrial park development and infrastructure rather than semiconductor manufacturing or supply.
summary: Eco World Project Management Sdn Bhd is involved in the development of the Eco World Industrial Park (VII) in Malaysia, which aims to create a high-quality industrial development platform. While the project supports various industries, it does not directly engage in semiconductor manufacturing or related services.

regional_presence.Malaysia: The company is developing the Eco World Industrial Park (VII) in the Vision Valley 2.0 economic corridor, which is strategically located near key transportation hubs.
